name: aronda Gallery – Flexible Image Gallery for Elementor
author: arondadigital

sections.description:
aronda Gallery – Structured galleries & flexible layouts for Elementor

The aronda Gallery extends Elementor with a versatile gallery function offering multiple layout types and extensive customization options. Present your images in a structured, modern and individual way – perfect for portfolios, references, products or visual content.
The gallery integrates directly into the Elementor editor and provides flexible layout options such as Grid, Masonry or Flavius (an advanced product-style layout with a main image and previews).
Thanks to well thought-out settings, you always stay in full control of structure, appearance and behavior of your content – without any coding.

  • Intuitive filter function
    Enable targeted navigation through your content – without reloading the page.

  • Search engine friendly & accessible
    Thanks to semantic markup and accessible code, your website remains easy to read not only for users but also for Google.

  • Optimized for performance
    Fast loading times and a resource-saving “Load More” mechanism ensure a smooth user experience – even with many items.

  • Individually customizable
    Adjust layout, colors, spacing and effects to match your design – directly in the Elementor editor, without programming knowledge.

The Filter Gallery integrates seamlessly into your existing web design and makes it easy for visitors to discover content in a structured way.

Key Features

  • Multiple layout types
    Choose between Masonry, Grid and Flavius depending on your use case and design requirements.

  • Masonry layout
    Dynamic layout based on image sizes – ideal for creative and irregular designs.

  • Grid layout
    Uniform display of all elements with equal item sizes – perfect for clean structures.

  • Flavius layout (product display)
    Main image with additional preview images – ideal for WooCommerce, product pages or for visual content that should stand out.

  • Custom sorting
    Sort content manually via drag & drop or automatically by date or randomly.

  • Load More function
    Content can be loaded step by step to improve performance and usability.

  • Responsive column control
    Define the number of columns individually for desktop, tablet and mobile devices.

  • Spacing & layout control
    Adjust spacing between images and the overall gallery height flexibly.

  • Custom navigation (Flavius)
    Choose between default icons, custom SVGs or no navigation.

  • Design customization
    Colors, sizes, hover effects and layout can be adjusted directly in the Elementor editor.

Use Cases

The aronda Gallery is particularly suitable for:

  • Portfolios
  • References
  • Product displays
  • WooCommerce shops
  • Image galleries
  • Projects
  • Agency websites
  • Photographer websites

In short: For all websites that want to present visual content in a structured and flexible way.

Compatible with the Elementor Website Builder

The aronda Gallery was specifically developed for Elementor and integrates fully into the editor.
Simply drag & drop the widget onto your page and configure content directly in the Elementor panel.
All settings – layout, images, navigation and design – can be adjusted without programming.

Free Version Features

The free version already includes:

  • Grid & Masonry layout
  • Elementor widget integration
  • Manual & automatic sorting
  • Responsive column control
  • Spacing settings
  • Basic design options
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP file through the WordPress Plugins > Add New screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Edit a page with Elementor.
  4. Add the aronda Filter Gallery widget to your layout.
  5. Configure the gallery and filter settings in the Elementor panel.
sections.faq:
What does the aronda Gallery do?

The aronda Gallery is an Elementor widget for displaying images in different layouts such as Grid, Masonry or Flavius, an advanced gallery with a main image and previews.

Does the plugin only work with Elementor?

Yes. The aronda Gallery is an add-on for Elementor and can only be used if Elementor is installed and activated.

Which layouts are available?

You can choose between three layout types:

  • Masonry (dynamic heights)
  • Grid (uniform layout)
  • Flavius (main image + preview images)

Can I change the order of images?

Yes. Sorting can be done manually via drag & drop or automatically by date or randomly.

Is there a “Load More” function?

Content can be loaded step by step using a “Load More” button. You can also define how many items are initially displayed and how many are loaded per click.

Can I make the gallery responsive?

Yes. As usual with Elementor, you can adjust these settings. Columns, spacing and layout can be customized individually for desktop, tablet and mobile.

Can I customize the navigation?

In the Flavius layout, navigation icons can be customized individually – including custom SVG files or icons from the media library.

Are images automatically optimized?

Optionally, images can be automatically resized to improve loading times and ensure SEO-friendly performance.

Do I need programming knowledge?

No. All settings can be configured directly in the Elementor editor.
